NOT A LEAK, AND HERE IS WHAT IS ACTUALLY HOLDING THESE ROWS SHUT: on these paths the product has no session to check, so an unguessable secret in the caller's own hand IS the credential — a booking's UUID from the customer's emailed link, or an invite token.
